newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares end off, demand seen at lows.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares end off, demand seen at lows.

text.p: Austrian shares ended 0.69 percent down on Thursday but off the session low thanks to some brisk buying into the dips.
The ATX index of 21 blue-chip shares closed at 1,068.71 -- 7.45 points down on the day. Earlier it touched a low of 1,064.89. Five shares ended up, two unchanged and 14 down.
"On the way down turnover was average but then there was a flood of orders at the bottom," said a trader.
Despite the bottom fishing, he forecast a test of support at 1,060 points over the next few days.
"Stock picking alone cannot hold the market up for long," another dealer noted.
Regional utility EVN, which presents its 1995/6 results on Tuesday, was among the most actively traded stocks.
"People are speculating that last year's cold winter will boost earnings," a trader said.
EVN closed six schillings up at 1,489 on 23,757 lots.
Vienna airport company Flughafen Wien was the day's biggest percentage gainer in brisk turnover, rising 0.77 percent to 534.1 schillings.
Creditanstalt bank preferred shares were the leading decliner, off 4.27 percent to 481.5 schillings.
November ATX futures stood 6.7 points down at 1,069.5. The all-share Vienna bourse index shed 1.54 points to close at 411.69. -- Vienna Newsroom, 43-1-53112-258
